title: Multiscale simulations reveal TDP-43 molecular-level interactions driving condensation.
authors: Ingolfsson, Helgi I; Rizuan, Azamat; Liu, Xikun; Mohanty, Priyesh; Souza, Paulo C T; Marrink, Siewert J; Bowers, Michael T; Mittal, Jeetain; Berry, Joel
one_liner_zh: 该文用多尺度分子动力学模拟（全原子、Martini 3、隐式溶剂 Cα 模型）构建全长 TDP-43 模型，系统研究其自/交叉互作与凝聚体形成机制，对象为含 IDR 的无序蛋白、聚焦 PPI 机制且方法为物理模拟，高度契合课题。
abstract: The RNA-binding protein TDP-43 is associated with mRNA processing and transport from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. TDP-43 localizes in the nucleus as well as accumulating in cytoplasmic condensates such as stress granules. Aggregation and formation of amyloid-like fibrils of cytoplasmic TDP-43 are hallmarks of numerous neurodegenerative diseases, most strikingly present in >90% of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) patients. If excessive accumulation of cytoplasmic TDP-43 causes, or is caused by, neurodegeneration is presently not known. In this work, we use molecular dynamics simulations at multiple resolutions to explore TDP-43 self- and cross-interaction dynamics. A full-length molecular model of TDP-43, all 414 amino acids, was constructed from select structures of the protein functional domains (N-terminal domain, and two RNA recognition motifs, RRM1 and RRM2) and modeling of disordered connecting loops and the low complexity glycine-rich C-terminus domain. All-atom CHARMM36m simulations of single TDP-43 proteins served as guides to construct a coarse-grained Martini 3 model of TDP-43. The Martini model and a coarser implicit solvent C⍺ model, optimized for disordered proteins, were subsequently used to probe TDP-43 interactions; self-interactions from single-chain full-length TDP-43 simulations, cross-interactions from simulations with two proteins and simulations with assemblies of dozens to hundreds of proteins. Our findings illustrate the utility of different modeling scales for accessing TDP-43 molecular-level interactions and suggest that TDP-43 has numerous interaction preferences or patterns, exhibiting an overall strong, but dynamic, association and driving the formation of biomolecular condensates.
abstract_zh: RNA结合蛋白TDP-43与mRNA加工及从细胞核到细胞质的运输相关。TDP-43定位于细胞核，同时也在细胞质凝聚体（如应激颗粒）中积累。细胞质TDP-43的聚集和淀粉样纤维形成是众多神经退行性疾病的标志，尤其在超过90%的肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者中显著存在。目前尚不清楚细胞质TDP-43的过度积累是导致神经退行性变的原因，还是其结果。在本工作中，我们使用多分辨率的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来探索TDP-43的自相互作用和交叉相互作用动态。构建了一个包含全部414个氨基酸的TDP-43全长分子模型，该模型基于蛋白质功能域（N端结构域和两个RNA识别基序RRM1和RRM2）的选定结构，以及对无序连接环和低复杂度甘氨酸富集C端结构域的建模。单个TDP-43蛋白的全原子CHARMM36m模拟作为指导，构建了TDP-43的粗粒化Martini 3模型。随后，使用Martini模型和针对无序蛋白优化的更粗粒隐式溶剂C⍺模型来探测TDP-43相互作用；自相互作用来自单链全长TDP-43模拟，交叉相互作用来自双蛋白模拟以及数十至数百个蛋白组装体的模拟。我们的发现展示了不同建模尺度在获取TDP-43分子水平相互作用方面的实用性，并表明TDP-43具有多种相互作用偏好或模式，表现出整体强但动态的关联，驱动生物分子凝聚体的形成。
